summary:
• Gemini Omni Flash — a video‑generation model that creates native 15‑second clips and supports multi‑turn conversational editing, lowering cost and simplifying short‑form production.
• GPT-6 Cyber — a cloud‑based LLM that scans code for exploitable bugs, proposes patches, and stays within defined permissions, accelerating security triage.
• Claude Code — a coding assistant that logs its suggestions, can assume AWS roles, and lets users set effort levels to control cost and security.
• Agentic Hacking Skills repository — a set of templates and skill modules enabling an LLM to act as a web security assistant, simplifying pen‑testing workflows.
• cvEngine — an open‑source, self‑hosted pipeline that continuously scans exposed assets, correlates them with current CVEs, and presents only actionable exploit findings.
• MCP (Model‑Tool Communication Protocol) — an open standard that defines how AI apps request tool actions from a server, enabling plug‑and‑play integration without hard‑coded APIs.
